usage: Receipt schema and order only. THIS IS NOT A RELEASE. Run examples/glass_autoresearch/hero_forecast.py {freeze|issue|score} [--role hot|cold|transfer|issue] --lock SHA256 with single-thread BLAS. Parent alone decides each release. No reruns: spends a private ticket before physical computation. Computations are restricted to explicitly supplied HERO banks/checkpoint and public rule. No access to the native archive from forecasting code.
all_releases: Commit PUBLIC/forecast-release-{stage}.json where stage is freeze, issue-{role} or score-{role}. Keys stage (exact filename suffix), mode (confirmatory/nonconfirmatory), design_sha256 of forecast-design.json, control_sha256 of forecast-control.json, inputs. Each input is {path: relative-to-specified-HERO-directory, sha256: full SHA256}. The release, design, control and all PUBLIC inputs must match committed Git blobs. The parent must also verify the upstream learner/rule/lineage admission. In nonconfirmatory mode freeze may measure its ONE named dev rule but no exams can be issued.
freeze: Also set critic_seed=6101. Inputs fit,tune,rule = WORK/{split}.npz; critic = WORK-relative nominated arm/rung lowest seed (same lowest reference as hero_rule; four shell scores, no best-seed selection); rule_spec=PUBLIC/rule.json. Model output WORK/frozen-forecasts.npz; commit PUBLIC/forecast-freeze.json with hash, alpha selection, raw/residual/conventional dev gain, absolute MSE, support, timing and disposition. Do not issue if any gate fails.
issue: Inputs freeze=PUBLIC/forecast-freeze.json, model=WORK/frozen-forecasts.npz, critic=same WORK checkpoint, blind=WORK/blind-{role}.npz. For role cold require preceding=PUBLIC/forecast-score-hot.json passed; transfer requires preceding=score-cold; issue requires preceding=score-transfer. First commit public predictions-{role}.{npz,json}, then and only then consider hidden-bank release. For cold/transfer do not seek labels with published exact-I FIT support below .90. Matching is fixed before any corresponding interiors. No issue interior exists.
score: Only roles hot,cold,transfer. Inputs receipt=PUBLIC/predictions-{role}.json, predictions=PUBLIC/predictions-{role}.npz, rule_spec=PUBLIC/rule.json and hidden=WORK/hidden-{role}.npz after independent bank's committed-issuance and roster checks. Commit resulting PUBLIC/forecast-score-{role}.json and forecast-calibration-{role}.png. No retraining or issuance inside scoring.
calibration_pilot: Protected prospective calibration ticket already executed via control entrypoint. Code uses frozen finite-parent sufficient statistics, not lattice configurations. Other upstream controls are independent. No authority to access native inputs is implied.
